verdict.rationale: Docs show a concrete quickstart path: install via `uv add typesafe-sdk` or `npm install @typesafe-ai/sdk`, then a walkthrough that adds a Noul/Choice/Score question, plus a no-code Playground to paste state and try a question before writing code. Community evidence corroborates quick, low-friction access (fast API responses, easy prototyping) supporting a 'minutes to first call' experience. Missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end runnable code snippet/curl example in the evidence pack, and independent confirmation of literal time-to-first-call.
